azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks enables AAD-V2 managed RBAC (role_based_access_control.azure_active_directory.managed = true) and depends on the AAD-V2 preview feature being registered, but it has no dependency on null_resource.register_aks_msi_preview_feature, which registers that feature and blocks until it reports Registered. Terraform can create the cluster before/while the feature registration is in progress, causing apply failures. Add depends_on (or otherwise sequence the cluster after the feature registration).

module.synapse_workspaces creates azurerm_key_vault_secret resources (sql_admin_password, sql_admin, synapse_name, synapse_rg_name) in the key vault from var.keyvault_id, but it does not depend on module.keyvault_access_policies. Every other module that writes key-vault secrets (mssql_servers, azuread_applications, azuread_users, virtual_machines) explicitly depends_on module.keyvault_access_policies so the deploying principal's access policy exists first. Without it the secret writes can fail with 403. Add depends_on = [module.keyvault_access_policies].

data.external.ase_ilb_ip has depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase], but its program already interpolates azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, so the ordering is already established implicitly; the explicit depends_on is redundant.

null_resource.grant_admin_consent has depends_on = [azuread_service_principal.app], but the local-exec environment already references azuread_service_principal.app.id, so the dependency is already implicit and the explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy has depends_on = [azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault], but recovery_vault_name already references azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name, so the dependency is already implicit and the explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway has depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub], but virtual_hub_id already references azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id, so the dependency is implicit and the explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway has depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub], but virtual_hub_id already references azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id, so the dependency is implicit and the explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway has depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub, ...], but virtual_hub_id already references azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id, so this portion of the explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway has depends_on = [..., azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration], but vpn_server_configuration_id already references azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id, so this portion of the explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_virtual_hub_connection.vhub_connection has depends_on = [module.networking, module.virtual_wans], but virtual_hub_id already references module.virtual_wans[...].virtual_hubs[...].id, so the dependency on module.virtual_wans is already established implicitly and this depends_on entry is redundant (the module.networking entry is still needed because networking is reached only through a local).
